items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I worked for four years with his show.

ctx.x: No. We only get residuals on the live ones, like Flip Wilson or Carol Burnett, but that's because they were done before a live audience. Other than live audience shows, the band gets nothing. That's one of the beefs we've had. Our leadership is really not on our side in some cases.
You're talking about the leadership of the Musicians Union.
